plan.analysis: Inclusion is the bottleneck: recall 0.22, 154 misses, mostly small (median 36px) and low-contrast faint smudges/elongated marks; round-1 tiny pastes (0.3-1.0, prefer_small) clearly did not help, so I shift to larger, learnable pastes and include the faint sources (287, 150, 11). Patches are decent (0.67) with small/low-contrast misses; keep the small-bias approach with a slightly higher floor. Scratches miss thin bright high-contrast lines (high-contrast recall only 0.33) plus faint thin lines; round-1 used all sources, so I now restrict to bright/faint thin-line sources matching the misses.
plan.rationale: Round 1's tiny inclusion pastes failed (recall still 0.22), so inclusion gets the largest share (25) with a learnable 0.6-1.4 scale, uniform weighting, and all sources including the faint low-contrast ones (287/150/11) to better match the faint missed marks. Patches (12) keep the small-bias that correlates with their 0.67 recall, just with a higher scale floor. Scratches (13) now copy only thin bright/faint line sources to target the missed high-contrast thin lines that round 1's all-source mix under-served. Totals 50; all headroom/cap/span/overlap constraints satisfied.

plan.analysis: Preview check: inclusion pastes are faint thin low-contrast marks matching the dominant faint streak/smudge misses; patches are dark irregular blobs matching the missed dark patches; scratches are thin bright lines matching the missed high-contrast thin lines. Sizes are learnable (no tiny unlearnable pastes). No unrealistic or wasted pastes, so the plan is confirmed.
plan.rationale: Preview confirms the pastes look right per class: faint thin inclusion marks, dark patch blobs, and bright thin scratch lines, all at learnable sizes. Inclusion gets the largest share (25) with a 0.6-1.4 scale and all sources (incl. faint 287/150/11) to fix the 0.22 recall; patches (12) keep small-bias; scratches (13) restricted to thin bright/faint line sources to target the missed high-contrast thin lines. Totals 50; all constraints satisfied.
